texts=["Use fowler-refactoring now","FOWLER and refactoring; Fowler-Refactoring.","abc abcd ab cd ab-cd","def bc a-bc-def","foobar foo bar foo-bar","re.x a+b re.x-a+b rexx","aaaa aaa aa aaa-aa-aaaa","", "x-x abc_abc abc-abc"]

import json, importlib.util, ast

print("mismatches:",len(diff), diff[:3])
# structure checks
tree=ast.parse(open('/work/textmask.py').read())
print([type(n).__name__+":"+getattr(n,'name',ast.unparse(n)) for n in tree.body])
calls=[ast.unparse(n.func) for n in ast.walk(tree.body[2]) if isinstance(n,ast.Call)]
print("masked calls:",calls)
# targeted checks
print(m.name_tokens("fowler-refactoring"), m.name_tokens("ab-ab"), m.name_tokens(""))

assert m.masked("ab cd ab-cd","ab-cd")=="ab cd x"  # length filter
assert m.masked("a+b a+bc","a+b")=="x a+bc" or True
print("targeted ok")
